entries.finding: WCAG 2.2 is a W3C Recommendation; SC 2.5.8 sets a minimum pointer target of 24 by 24 CSS pixels and SC 2.5.7 requires an alternative to dragging.
entries.implication: Token target-min is 24px on the web and 44pt in the app; every drag has a tap alternative.

entries.finding: Core Web Vitals good thresholds are LCP 2.5 s, INP 200 ms and CLS 0.1, assessed at the 75th percentile of field visits.
entries.implication: Lab runs use these as budgets and are never reported as field data.

entries.finding: GSAP including ScrollTrigger is free for commercial use under a no-charge licence that is not open source and prohibits use in tools competing with Webflow visual animation building.
entries.implication: Installed from npm by the site, flagged by the audit for a human licence decision.

entries.finding: Expo SDK 58 uses React Native 0.88 and React 19.3 and runs only on the New Architecture.
entries.implication: Mobile template targets SDK 58 with Reanimated 4 and Gesture Handler 3.

entries.finding: Buyers are homeowners, not engineers; launch markets are the UK and the UAE.
The category presents itself either as industrial equipment (dark dashboards) or as a gadget (white gloss).
entries.basis: Stated in the client brief as category conventions; no competitor audit was performed.
